label: Incomplete if statements
subgoals: Trace each path through the block for every output
Mark an output latched when some path leaves it unassigned
Clear the latch with a default assignment at the top of the block

label: If/else with uneven assignments
subgoals: Check each variable against both arms of the if/else
Count a variable as complete only if it is defaulted or assigned in every arm
Add the widths of the incomplete variables

label: Case statements and full coverage
subgoals: Check whether the case items cover every selector value
Check that each variable is assigned in every item or by a default
Avoid full_case pragmas that hide the mismatch from simulation
